name: HIRO Industries
long_description: HIRO Industries builds affordable, easy-to-use robots for real work. Our first robot, Origin, is a two-armed robot designed for tasks like sorting, packing, kitting, and assembly. We combine teleoperation with AI to help robots perform useful work today while collecting data to improve their autonomy over time. Our longer-term goal is to build an American robotics platform that makes capable robots accessible to more businesses and developers.
one_liner: We’re building an American robotics platform, starting with Origin,…
